title: EMS Scheduler Configuration
description: Charge/discharge scheduling configuration for the scheduler module. Defines operational mode (manual, time-of-day windows, or power curve), time windows, and day/night transition times. This schema is hot-reloadable — schedule changes take effect without restarting the service. All fields are x-mutable: true for live schedule editing from the HMI.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

mode.description: Scheduler operating mode. 'manual' = operator dispatches via HMI commands; 'time_of_day' = automated charge/discharge windows; 'curve' = 15-minute interval power setpoint curve.

time_windows.description: Array of time-of-day charge/discharge windows. Used when mode='time_of_day'. Windows define recurring daily schedules with start/end times and power setpoints.

items.description: A single charge/discharge time window with start time, end time, action, and power setpoint.

start.description: Window start time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Example: '06:00' for 6 AM.

end.description: Window end time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Example: '18:00' for 6 PM. End time may be on the following day (e.g., '06:00' end after '22:00' start).

action.description: Scheduled action for this time window. 'charge' fills the battery; 'discharge' exports/supplies load; 'idle' holds current SOC.

power_kw.description: Power setpoint for this window in kilowatts. Must be within max_charge_kw or max_discharge_kw limits defined in control_config.

day_night.description: Day/night transition times used by control_manager source_priority selection. Defines when the system switches between day_order and night_order dispatch priorities.

day_start.description: Time when daytime mode begins (solar priority active). 24-hour HH:MM format. Example: '06:00'.

night_start.description: Time when nighttime mode begins (solar inactive). 24-hour HH:MM format. Example: '18:00'.

power_curve.description: 96-point daily power setpoint curve at 15-minute intervals. Used when mode='curve'. Index 0 = 00:00-00:15, index 95 = 23:45-00:00. Positive = discharge (kW export), negative = charge (kW import). All 96 points must be provided.

items.description: Power setpoint for this 15-minute interval in kW. Positive = discharge, negative = charge.
